	<div class="tve-cb"><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv-columns" style="--tcb-col-el-width: 590;"><div class="tcb-flex-row v-2 tcb--cols--3"><div class="tcb-flex-col"><div class="tcb-col"><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ebf79ea1" data-tag="h3" style=""><blockquote class="" data-end="2116" data-start="2069"><h3 data-css="tve-u-199ae97c496" data-end="2116" data-start="2071" style="">Work Remotely by the atlantic ocean</h3></blockquote></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ebf83cd7" data-tag="h3" style=""><p data-css="tve-u-199ae9a7276" data-end="2351" data-start="2118" style="text-align: justify;">Our coworking space is built for focus, high-speed fiber internet, ergonomic workstations, and quiet zones when you need deep work. Step outside for a stretch in the garden, grab a coffee, and you’re meters away from the sea breeze, and steps away from your accommodation. You’ll meet entrepreneurs, designers, and freelancers who share your rhythm, productive mornings, windy afternoons, and sunset braais.</p></div></div></div><div class="tcb-flex-col"><div class="tcb-col"><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ebfd7d4d" data-tag="h3" style=""><blockquote class="" data-end="2116" data-start="2069"><h3 data-css="tve-u-199ae97c496" data-end="2116" data-start="2071">The Ultimate Kitesurfing Base</h3></blockquote></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ebfd8dae" data-tag="h3" style=""><p data-css="tve-u-199fcb24736" data-end="2942" data-start="2725" style="text-align: justify;">Located minutes from Blouberg’s world-famous kite beach, Boardrooms accommodation is perfectly positioned for wind chasers kitesurfers, windsurfers, wingers and surfers. Store your gear safely, rinse off in outdoor showers, and hit the lagoon or ocean in seconds. We live for the wind, and when it’s blowing, work can wait, if you are planning on having lessons we also have accommodation in Langebaan <a href="http://www.oysterrock.com" target="_blank" class="" style="outline: none;" data-css="tve-u-199fcd13987">Oysterrock</a></p></div></div></div><div class="tcb-flex-col" data-css="tve-u-199fcadb4af" style=""><div class="tcb-col"><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ec1b4868" data-tag="h3" style=""><blockquote class="" data-end="2116" data-start="2069"><h3 data-css="tve-u-199ae97c496" data-end="2116" data-start="2071">More Than a Stay, It’s aN EXPERIENCE</h3></blockquote></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ec1b6025" data-tag="h3" style=""><p data-css="tve-u-199fcb259ac" data-end="2942" data-start="2725" style="">Our Blouberg coliving space brings together digital nomads, remote professionals, and kitesurfers from around the world. Each private room is designed for comfort, while shared spaces spark collaboration, friendships, and impromptu surf sessions. Whether you’re chasing wind, waves, or Wi-Fi, you’ll find all there here. We have added an outdoor mini gym and hot tub so you save on gym membership and travel, our yoga mats are free to use, just bring your vibes.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div>

https://boardrooms.capetown/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/boardriders-blouberg-accommodation-768x559.jpeg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 379px) 100vw, 379px" /></span></div></div></div><div class="tcb-flex-col c-66" data-css="tve-u-199ebe49b13" style=""><div class="tcb-col" data-css="tve-u-199ebe4b063" style=""><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ec11251e" data-tag="h3" style=""><blockquote class="" data-end="2116" data-start="2069"><h3 data-css="tve-u-199ae97c496" data-end="2116" data-start="2071">LOCATION: The Blouberg Experience</h3></blockquote></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_text_element tve_empty_dropzone" data-css="tve-u-199ec1151ab" data-tag="h3" style=""><p data-css="tve-u-199ae9a5cf6" data-end="2942" data-start="2725" style="">Blouberg is where Cape Town’s surf culture meets city life. You’re close enough to explore the Mother City, yet far enough to unwind in a laid-back coastal bubble. Enjoy restaurants, beach walks, and consistent wind that draws water sport lovers year-round, drinks at Pokalocos after your session, Burgers at Jerrys, Coffee at Atlantic surf, Sushi at Catch22 or catchup with the kite crew at Highfive, and one of our favorites is to watch sport on the big screen TV at He's Not Here.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div>
</div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv-page-section tve-height-update" data-inherit-lp-settings="1">
